INSERT INTO md_sync_batch ( batch_no, request_key, source_system_code, scope_type, organization_id, environment_code, data_category, sync_mode, source_type, source_organization_id, source_endpoint_id, source_endpoint_version, full_rule_evidence, query_started_at, query_ended_at, diagnosis_category, diagnosis_version, data_trade_code, count_trade_code, batch_status, is_active, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{batchNo}, #{creation.requestKey}, #{sourceSystemCode}, #{scopeType}, #{organizationId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{creation.environment}, #{creation.category}, #{creation.mode}, NULL, #{sourceOrganizationId,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{creation.sourceEndpointId}, #{creation.sourceEndpointVersion,jdbcType=VARBINARY}, #{creation.fullRuleEvidence,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, #{creation.rangeStart,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{creation.rangeEnd,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, NULL, NULL, #{dataTradeCode}, #{countTradeCode,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, 'CREATED', 1, #{actor}, #{actor} ); SELECT CONVERT(BIGINT, SCOPE_IDENTITY());
SELECT FROM md_sync_batch batches LEFT JOIN org_organization organizations ON organizations.id = batches.organization_id WHERE batches.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE md_sync_batch SET batch_status = 'FETCHING', started_at = SYSUTCDATETIME(), finished_at = NULL, failure_code = NULL, failure_summary = NULL, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{batchId} AND batch_status = 'CREATED' AND row_version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM md_sync_batch batches LEFT JOIN sys_external_endpoint endpoint WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) ON endpoint.id = batches.source_endpoint_id WHERE batches.id = #{batchId} AND batches.source_endpoint_id IS NOT NULL AND (endpoint.id IS NULL OR endpoint.is_enabled = 0 OR endpoint.verification_status <> 'VERIFIED' OR endpoint.row_version <> batches.source_endpoint_version) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
